stage: E — paired teacher-forced per-problem NLL from the 12 saved V1 adapters
reason: Accelerator taken by an unrelated job from a sibling worktree part-way through the pass: PID 162912, RineyaBeta-supa-fwa-v1 scripts/profile_scaling.py --lengths 8192 16384, holding ~6.5 GiB at 100% utilisation. The GPU was idle (7185 MiB free, no compute apps) when the pass was launched, so the pre-flight check passed and the contention began afterwards.
what_happened: The pass did not fail. It ran roughly 100x slower than expected -- 42 of 800 problems in about ten minutes against an estimated 60-90 seconds per run -- and wrote a partial file. That is the dangerous failure mode: silent, slow, and it leaves an artifact that looks like data.
action_taken: Stopped the Stage E pass rather than competing for the device.
Deleted every partial teacher_forced_per_problem.jsonl so no incomplete file can enter an analysis.

Added a pre-flight accelerator gate to scripts/teacher_forced_endpoint.py (--min-free-mib, --max-busy-util) that refuses and names the competing process, because trainer_running() only detects DAST's own trainers and cannot see sibling worktrees.
claim_boundary: Stage E is NOT measured. This is not a scientific null and says nothing about whether the teacher-forced endpoint validates. Do not cite the partial run, which no longer exists on disk.

prior_expectation_recorded_before_measur.note: Recorded now so it cannot be adjusted after seeing the result.
prior_expectation_recorded_before_measur.expectation: The aggregate LM loss already ranks final_repeated < baseline < ordered < reverse, whereas ACCURACY ranks baseline > final_repeated = reverse > ordered. state_reverse is therefore the WORST arm on teacher-forced loss while being middling on accuracy. If the per-problem endpoint reproduces that aggregate pattern it will FAIL the validation gate's 'state_ordered is the worst arm' criterion, and the honest reading would be that teacher-forced NLL tracks auxiliary-loss interference with LM fitting rather than reasoning capability.
prior_expectation_recorded_before_measur.secondary_observation: Mean gold-token probability is about 0.9998 and the per-problem NLL distribution is extremely skewed (top 5% of problems carried 63.5% of total NLL in the partial run). Teacher forcing is near-perfect while free generation fails ~11% of the time, so the two endpoints may be measuring different things by construction.

next: Re-run when the accelerator is idle: for each of the 12 run dirs, python scripts/teacher_forced_endpoint.py --run runs/<dir>, then python scripts/teacher_forced_compare.py --out artifacts/stage_e_verdict.json. The compare script enforces the validation gate and will report NOT VALIDATED if the V1 ordering is not reproduced.
